prompt: In a vibrant anime style, the scene unfolds at a high-altitude mountain campsite surrounded by jagged peaks. On the left side of the frame, a girl with short blue hair sits cross-legged on a green sleeping bag, her eyes wide as she looks at a crackling campfire in the center. Next to her, a small orange cat curls up tightly, its tail twitching slightly. The fire itself burns brightly, casting warm glows on the surrounding rocks. To the right of the fire, a man in a red scarf stands tall, pointing toward the distant snowy summit with his gloved hand. Beside him, a brown dog sits patiently, looking up at the man with eager anticipation. In the background, near a large pine tree, a woman with long braids hangs a metal pot over a secondary stove, steam rising gently from it. A young boy in a yellow jacket runs toward the group, holding a wooden stick firmly in both hands. Near the tent entrance, an older man with glasses reads a map, his brow furrowed in concentration. A black backpack rests on the ground next to him, zipped shut and sturdy. Finally, a silver thermos sits on a folding table near the foreground, reflecting the moonlight. There is no modern technology like smartphones or laptops visible in the scene. There is no rain or stormy weather disrupting the calm night. The girl on the left maintains her seated pose throughout. The man in the red scarf keeps his arm extended while pointing. The brown dog remains still beside its owner. The woman with braids focuses entirely on the hanging pot. The boy approaches the central group with energy. The older man studies the map intently. The cat stays close to the girl. The thermos remains untouched on the table. The backpack lies undisturbed near the reader. The fire continues to burn steadily in the middle.
